settings.question: Can I really check the specs before paying?
settings.answer: Yes. Every laptop has its own AnyDesk ID and computer name. Book a five-minute session and we connect you to that exact machine — you can open Task Manager, Device Manager or run CrystalDiskInfo yourself.

settings.question: What does battery health 94% mean?
settings.answer: It compares the battery's current capacity with its original design capacity. 94% means the battery still holds 94% of what it did when new. We also list the cycle count and real screen-on time.

settings.question: Is the SSD really 1 TB?
settings.answer: We photograph the CrystalDiskInfo readout for each unit. You'll see the exact model, capacity, power-on hours and SSD life percentage — not just what the listing says.

settings.question: Do you deliver outside Lahore?
settings.answer: Yes. Cash on delivery across Pakistan, with same-day delivery inside Lahore. Outstation orders are booked with a tracked courier and usually arrive in 2–3 working days.

settings.question: What warranty do I get?
settings.answer: Every unit includes our 14-day no-questions return window and a 30-day workshop warranty covering hardware faults. Extended warranty is available on select units — ask us before ordering.

settings.question: How do I pay?
settings.answer: Cash on delivery, bank transfer or JazzCash. For COD, you can inspect the laptop at the door before handing over the money.
